run_layout_evaluation: run layout evaluation on a dataset of document images with ground truth and predictions
create_layout_evaluator: create a LayoutEvaluator instance with optional label mapping and intermediate evaluations path
extract_layout_data: extract layout bounding box data from ground truth and predicted DoclingDocuments
compute_average_iou: compute average IoU for label-matched bounding boxes across multiple IoU thresholds
summarize_evaluation_results: summarize layout evaluation results into a sorted table of per-class mAP scores
